name: Irvine Spectrum Center
summary: Happening open-air mall with dozens of shops, services & restaurants, a Ferris wheel & a multiplex.
description: The Irvine Spectrum Center is Southern California's premier outdoor shopping destination celebrating 30 years of excellence, featuring dining, shopping, and entertainment including a Giant Wheel and Carousel. Located in the heart of Irvine, this vibrant lifestyle center offers holiday celebrations, ice skating, nightly tree lighting ceremonies, and a dynamic mix of restaurants spanning full-service to casual dining options.
demographics: The Irvine Spectrum Center attracts affluent, educated families and young professionals from Irvine and surrounding Orange County communities, with visitors typically in the 25-54 age range and above-average household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area encompasses some of California's most desirable ZIP codes, drawing tech industry employees, dual-income families, and upscale shoppers seeking premium retail and dining experiences. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for experiential retail, with visitors spending extended time enjoying the center's entertainment attractions, upscale restaurants, and curated tenant mix that balances accessible luxury with contemporary lifestyle brands.
